draft.emotion: warm and respectful, acknowledging a fundamental bond of family
notes: Often preceded by คุณ (khun) as คุณพ่อ (khun phâaw) to sound more polite, especially when speaking about someone else's father.
Also used before a mother's or child's name, or by older men as a warm first-person pronoun ('I') when speaking to younger people.
